title: esp32bench circuit
description: Virtual parts placed on one project's board for the simulator. Version 1.x; 1.1 adds models beyond LED and button, several pins per part, I2C placement and properties, 1.2 adds `controls`, where a part's sliders were left, 1.3 adds `at`, where the app's canvas shows a part, and still reads 1.0 files (`pin`, `activeLow`). Saved by the desktop app per project and board; designed so the project manifest can carry the same data later. Pins are GPIO numbers. Firmware-level: an LED is lit when its pin drives it; no electrical behaviour is modelled.

kind.description: A part model's id: led, button, switch, rgb-led, ... (schema/part-model).

pin.description: The GPIO, for a model with one pin.

activeLow.description: Circuit 1.0's shorthand for props.activeLow. Still read; not written by 1.1.

pins.description: GPIOs by the model's pin names.

controls.description: Where the part's sliders were left (1.2), by control name; applied when a simulation starts. Each must be a slider of the part's model, within its range.

at.description: Where the app's canvas shows the part, once moved there (1.3). Only the drawing: the part works the same anywhere.
